query: Who won the Battle of Waterloo?
generated_response:
The Battle of Waterloo was won by Napoleon Bonaparte's Grande Armée against the British Army led by General Sir Arthur Wellesley. The battle took place in 1815, after Napoleon had been defeated at the Battle of Waterloo and retreated to Paris.

Napoleon's army, under the leadership of Marshal Lucien Buonaparte and General Jean-Jacques Élemeaux-Carême, was composed of roughly 240,000 soldiers. The British Army, led by General Wellington, had about 180,000 troops.

The battle was a decisive victory for Napoleon's army, as they were able to outmaneuver and outfight the British forces. This allowed them to retreat to Paris, where they remained in control of the country until the end of the war.

The Battle of Waterloo is considered one of the greatest military battles of all time and has been celebrated in popular culture ever since.
